turns.text: I'd say achieving a healthy work-life balance is one of the biggest challenges for professionals in big cities nowadays.
In my previous role at a software house, it wasn't unusual for us to work late into the night to meet client deadlines.
Over time I realised that this was taking a toll on my health, so I started setting clearer boundaries with my manager.
Interestingly, my productivity actually improved, because I was better rested and more focused during working hours.
I think employers are gradually recognising this, and some companies have started offering flexible or hybrid arrangements.
